item.title: Injured WWE Superstar Return Could Happen Sooner Than Anyone Expected
item.description: There is encouraging news regarding the status of Chad Gable, who has been sidelined for several months while recovering from injury. Backstage expectations are that the Raw standout is edging closer to an in ring return, with optimism growing that he could be back on television sooner rather than later.
